مُؤَثَّلٌ Having root, or a foundation; or firm, or established, and firmly rooted or founded: (S:) or having a permanent source, or firm foundation: (Munjid of Kr:) or of old foundation or origin: or collected together so as to [become stable or permanent, or] have root or a foundation: (T:) or old; of ancient origin; or of long standing: (M, TA:) or permanent: (IAar:) (tropical:) applied to glory, honour, dignity, nobility, or high rank; (T, Kr, S, M, TA;) and so ↓ أَثِيلٌ : (S, TA:) and to wealth, or property: (Kr, S:) and to anything; (T, M;) and so ↓ أَثِيلٌ , and ↓ مُتَأَثِّلٌ : (M:) and ↓ آثِلٌ , also, has the first of these significations, applied to dominion. (T.) ―
-b2- Prepared, disposed, arranged, or put into a right or good state. (AA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
